title: 第1792章 云霜儿与洪九联手第1791章 好快的剑
lines: 没有什么比实战能让修士更快提升战力了。
很多修士在战斗中不断的领悟，不断的突破。
以前叶风的战力和修为境界不匹配，他的战力是远远高于他真实的修为境界的。
现在他的战力和修为境界依旧不匹配，但却反过来的，现在他的修为境界是高于他的战力的。
想要让二者齐平，就两种方法，其一是努力修炼云海宗的剑诀神通，身法步法，快速的提高自己的战力。
其二是与高手切磋，也能快速提高自己的战力。
现在的叶风，不论是体内真元，神识神念，速度，还是瞬间的爆发力，都远远超过之前。
只是他还无法完美的驾驭自己现在的力量。
云霜儿作为修士自然明白这一点，所以她才会和叶风斗剑，想要叶风尽快的将战力提上来。
云霜儿知道叶风的近战有多强大，所以她出剑又快又猛，试图逼出叶风最大的潜力。
奈何她还是小看了叶风，也高看了自己。
云霜儿的修为境界不比叶风弱，可是她的寒汐剑是寒冰属性的仙剑，叶风的紫电青霜是雷电属性的仙剑，在近战中，紫青神剑占据巨大优势的。
不论云霜儿如何猛攻，叶风都能轻易的化解。
云霜儿能感觉的出，自己已经将速度施展到了极限，而叶风却没有达到极限。
叶风其实也很想看看自己现在的战力极限在哪里。
他感觉到自己体内那股汹涌澎湃的元力如同被闸门拦住的洪水，每一次出剑格挡都只开了窄窄一条缝隙，溢出的力量微不足道。他想
要打开那闸门，想要让那股力量倾泻而出，可又担心不小心伤到云霜儿。
于是他便在云霜儿的快攻之中，不断地微调自己的力道。每一剑都恰到好处地化解云霜儿的攻势。
两人都是高手，肉眼是很难捕捉到彼此的剑锋的，所以二人此刻的神识念力，都牢牢的锁定对方。
结界范围内，二人身形闪烁，剑芒交织，噼里啪啦的撞击声此起彼伏。
纵然之前云霜儿布置了隔音结界，但远在百丈之外祠堂内的玉林上人，依旧将二人感知的清清楚楚。
祠堂内不仅只有玉林上人，还有洪九。
洪九今天白天和秦楚楚出去约会了，天黑后才回来。
如今掌门离开了，洪九晚上便和师父一起住在祠堂内。
不过洪九显然没有察觉到此刻叶风与云霜儿正在斗法切磋，他正在打坐修炼。
玉林上人看了一眼打坐修炼中的洪九，道：“洪九……”
洪九闻言，睁开眼睛，道：“师父，怎么了？”
玉林上人道：“你刚刚达到神寂境，实战切磋可以快速提高你的修为，此刻叶风和云霜儿正在切磋，你可以去看看，加入其中，对你有好处的。”
洪九诧异道：“啊？大晚上他们在切磋？”
洪九拎着焚天神剑走出祠堂，果然看到北面竹楼外剑光闪烁，却没有声音传来，想来是被布置了隔音结界。
content_en:
Nothing can help a monk improve his combat power faster than actual combat.
Many monks continue to realize and make breakthroughs in battle.
In the past, Ye Feng's combat power did not match his cultivation level. His combat power was far higher than his actual cultivation level.
Now his combat power and cultivation realm still don't match, but the opposite is true. Now his cultivation realm is higher than his combat power.
If you want to make the two equal, there are two ways. One is to work hard to practice Yunhai Sect's sword skills, body skills and footwork to quickly improve your combat power.
The second is to compete with masters, and you can quickly improve your combat power.
Now Ye Feng, whether it is the true energy in his body, his spiritual consciousness, his speed, or his instantaneous explosive power, it is far more than before.
It's just that he still can't perfectly control his current power.
As a monk, Yun Shuang'er naturally understood this, so she fought with Ye Feng in a sword fight, hoping that Ye Feng would increase his fighting power as soon as possible.
Yun Shuang'er knew how powerful Ye Feng was in melee combat, so she used her sword fast and fiercely, trying to force out Ye Feng's maximum potential.
However, she still underestimated Ye Feng and underestimated herself.
Yun Shuang'er's cultivation level is no weaker than Ye Feng, but her Hanxi Sword is an ice-attribute fairy sword, and Ye Feng's Purple Lightning Qingshuang is a lightning-attribute fairy sword. In close combat, the Purple Green Divine Sword has a huge advantage.
No matter how fiercely Yun Shuang'er attacks, Ye Feng can easily resolve it.
Yun Shuang'er could feel that she had reached the limit of speed, but Ye Feng had not reached the limit.
Ye Feng actually wanted to see where his current combat power limit was.
He felt that the surging Yuan Power in his body was like a flood blocked by a gate. Every time he used his sword to block, only a narrow gap opened, and the power that overflowed was negligible. he wanted to
I want to open the gate, want to let the power pour out, but I am worried about accidentally hurting Yun Shuang'er.
So he continued to fine-tune his strength during Yun Shuang'er's quick attacks. Each sword was just right to neutralize Yun Shuang'er's offensive.
Both of them are masters, and it is difficult for the naked eye to catch each other's sword edges, so at this moment, their spiritual consciousness is firmly locked on each other.
Within the barrier, the two figures flickered, their swords intertwined, and crackling sounds came one after another.
Even though Yun Shuang'er had arranged a soundproof barrier before, Master Yulin, who was a hundred feet away in the ancestral hall, could still perceive the two of them clearly.
There was not only Master Yulin in the ancestral hall, but also Hong Jiu.
Hong Jiu went out on a date with Qin Chuchu during the day and came back after dark.
Now that the master has left, Hong Jiu lives with his master in the ancestral hall at night.
However, Hong Jiu obviously didn't realize that Ye Feng and Yun Shuang'er were fighting and discussing skills at this moment, and he was meditating.
Master Yulin glanced at Hong Jiu who was meditating and said, "Hong Jiu..."
Hearing this, Hong Jiu opened his eyes and said, "Master, what's wrong?"
Master Yulin said: "You have just reached the realm of Divine Silence. Practical competition can quickly improve your cultivation. Ye Feng and Yun Shuang'er are currently competing. You can go and take a look. It will be good for you to join them."
Hong Jiu said in surprise: "Huh? Are they sparring at night?"
Hong Jiu walked out of the ancestral hall carrying the Burning Heaven Divine Sword. Sure enough, he saw the sword light flashing outside the bamboo building in the north, but no sound came from it. It must have been a soundproof barrier.
title_en: Chapter 1792 Yun Shuang'er and Hong Jiu join forces Chapter 1791 What a fast sword
